description: This file defines error types, constants, and helper functions for handling MCP (likely 'Mesh Control Plane' or similar) related errors. It includes structures for representing errors, various categories of errors (such as installation, build, startup, environment), methods for formatting and providing suggestions for errors, and functions for creating specific error instances.

classes.name: MCPOperationError
classes.description: Struct representing a detailed MCP operation error with context, type, message, and optional cause, output, and metadata.

classes.name: ErrorFormatter
classes.description: Structure to format error messages, supporting verbose and color options.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Implements the error interface, returning a string representation of the error.

methods.name: Unwrap
methods.description: Returns the underlying cause of the error.

methods.name: DetailedError
methods.description: Provides a detailed string with full error message, context, stdout, and stderr.

methods.name: GetSuggestion
methods.description: Returns a helpful suggestion based on the error type and message content.

methods.name: WithContext
methods.description: Adds contextual key-value pair to the error.

methods.name: WithOutput
methods.description: Attaches command output (stdout/stderr) to the error.

methods.name: NewMCPOperationError
methods.description: Creates a new MCP error of a specified type with operation, serverID, and message.

methods.name: NewMCPOperationErrorWithCause
methods.description: Creates a new MCP error wrapping an existing error.

methods.name: CommandExecutionError
methods.description: Creates an error for command execution failures, adjusting error type based on operation.

methods.name: CapabilityDiscoveryError
methods.description: Creates an error related to NPC capability discovery failure.

methods.name: TemplateError
methods.description: Creates an error related to template processing failures.

methods.name: MCPValidationError
methods.description: Creates an error for validation failures.

methods.name: ProtocolError
methods.description: Creates an error related to protocol communication issues.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats an error into a string based on verbosity and color settings.

methods.name: FormatWithColors
methods.description: Formats an error message with optional color coding (currently just passes through).
